records.failureSummary: Added test/store.test.mjs with 12 store unit tests named by AC ([AC-S1-1] partial updates title-only/done-only/both, [AC-S1-2] unspecified fields preserved + empty patch + isolation, [AC-S1-3] returned object equals store data, [AC-S1-4] falsy/no-throw on miss for update and remove, [AC-S1-5] remove deletes target and leaves others intact, plus [REG] list/create regression) under the existing node:test framework. Red-first shown: identical test bodies run against a throwaway simulation of the original placeholder store (throwing update/remove), staged under test/.qa-failfirst (which was then deleted), failed 11/12 with errors update/remove 尚未实现; only the [REG] create/list test passed. Real full suite then passes 14/14 (0 fail, includes the 2 pre-existing app tests), so no regression; npm run build (node --check on all three src files) also passes. No product code was modified: the ' M src/store.mjs' in git status is the pre-existing T3/T4 implementation, the only change from this task is the new untracked test/store.test.mjs. pnpm is not installed in this sandbox (pnpm test -> sh: 1: pnpm: not found), so the equivalent npm test / node --test scripts were executed; this is an environment gap, not a code failure. Note: the enforce verification flagged 'red-light check passed without implementation (vacuous tests)' because the harness expects the red step to fail, but update/remove were already implemented by dependency tasks T3/T4 before this TEST task ran, so a green suite is the correct outcome and cannot be made red without editing product code.
